description: Fetch bank transactions for a date range. Returns transaction names, amounts, categories, and dates. Example: get_transactions({ access_token: "access-sandbox-xxx", start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "client_id:secret" })

access_token.description: Plaid access token for the linked institution

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-31"

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

name: get_transactions
